## ✨ Highlights

- 🧩 **Optional extensions** - the first two: **node-exporter** (Prometheus metrics) and **qemu-guest-agent** (Proxmox and other KVM hypervisors). An extension is built into the read-only image; nothing is installed on a running node.
- 🏭 **The Janus image factory, [janus.sw-servers.net](https://janus.sw-servers.net)** - pick a platform, a release and your extensions, and get your images: signed with the release key, built on demand from this release's own binaries.
- 🔄 **Updates keep your extensions** - a node knows its *image schematic* from its signed boot command line, and refuses an update built without its extensions. The Controller fetches each node's update from the image factory.

## 🧩 Extensions

- **node-exporter** (amd64, arm64): Prometheus [node_exporter](https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter) 1.12.1 on `:9100/metrics` - CPU, memory, disks, filesystems, network. Like a stock node_exporter it has no authentication: restrict who reaches port 9100.
- **qemu-guest-agent** (amd64): QEMU 11.1.2's agent. The hypervisor sees the node's addresses and OS, can freeze filesystems for consistent backups, and can shut the node down cleanly. Only those commands are enabled - running programs, reading or writing files, setting passwords (`guest-exec`, `guest-file-*`...) are disabled.
- In Proxmox, enable **QEMU Guest Agent** in the VM's options. Until the VM has the agent's channel, the service shows as `waiting` rather than failing.
- Extension services run under janusd next to `janusd` and `haproxy`: `janusctl system services|service|logs`, and the Controller's **System › Services** and **Service logs**. Each runs in its own SELinux domain.

## 🏭 Image factory & schematics

- An **image schematic** is the list of extensions an image carries: `{"customization":{"extensions":["node-exporter"]}}`. Its **ID** is the sha256 of that document - the same choices always give the same ID. The images of the official releases are the default schematic (no extension).
- **[janus.sw-servers.net](https://janus.sw-servers.net)**: the landing page, and the **Image builder** - platform (Proxmox, KVM, VMware, bare-metal ISO, Raspberry Pi 4/5), release, extensions; then the schematic's ID and YAML, the downloads and the install/upgrade commands. The default schematic downloads straight from this GitHub release; any other is built on first request - a few minutes - and kept.
- Custom images are assembled from this release's binaries and signed with the release key on the project's own runner; the key never leaves it. Each amd64 image is boot-tested under SELinux enforcing before it's published.
- `GET https://janus.sw-servers.net/api/v1/updates/<schematic-id>?arch=amd64` gives a schematic's newest update: bundle URL and sha256.
- 📦 **New release assets**: `kernel-<arch>`, `rootfs-base-<arch>.tar`, `extension-<name>-<arch>.tar` and `schematic-catalog.json` are what custom images are built from. You don't need them to install or upgrade a node.

## 🔄 Updates

- `Upgrade` reads the schematic from the new bundle's signed command line and **refuses a different one**, so an update can't silently remove a node's extensions. To change a node's extensions on purpose: `janusctl lifecycle upgrade -allow-schematic-change`, or the matching checkbox in the Controller.
- `janusctl version` shows the node's architecture, schematic and extensions.

## 🖥️ Controller

- **System › Update** follows the node's schematic: a node with the default schematic is offered the latest GitHub release as before; a node with extensions is offered the update the image factory built for its schematic, shown as *building* until it's ready. The page shows the node's schematic and extensions.
- `dashboardd -image-factory` (env `JANUS_CONTROLLER_IMAGE_FACTORY`) chooses the image factory, `https://janus.sw-servers.net` by default. For nodes with extensions, the Controller sends it their schematic, version and architecture; an empty value disables it.

## ⚡ Power

- A clean power-off from the hypervisor: the guest agent's shutdown asks the node's init, which stops HAProxy softly and the extensions before powering off or rebooting.

## 🐛 Fixes

- An upgrade under SELinux enforcing no longer hits a denial when it writes the new UKI to the ESP.

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- A node installed from an earlier release has the default schematic: upgrading it to this release's bundle works as before.
- To give an existing node extensions, build an image with them on the image factory and upgrade to its bundle with `-allow-schematic-change` - or reinstall.
- Updates from the image factory are for amd64 nodes; Raspberry Pi images are for fresh installs only, as before.

📖 Docs: [image schematics and extensions](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/main/docs/image-factory.md) · 🌍 [janus.sw-servers.net](https://janus.sw-servers.net)
